reason: One shared i18n package replaces duplicated product runtime and pilot validation code. Separate React/tooling entry points keep Node tooling out of browser bundles; nine CodeMirror dictionaries provide true per-language lazy chunks. A dedicated unconditional bin imports CLI main so npm-style symlinks cannot silently bypass validation. CLI composition reuses runtime merge semantics rather than adding a second collision implementation; the source guard follows rendered React state and valid Lingui macro forms. No application adopts it in this change. One executable catalogue-union module is shared by the runtime and clean-checkout CLI without requiring generated dist; its runtime re-export preserves the public API (one file, two relative imports, one export declaration).
